_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Owe udi mwingilanga Kilondike Kalondanji. Mwelo obe udi kuimwena kadi zonse ku mizungu ya kipindi.

Mikano ya Mwingilango:
- Mizungu ya kipindi (F1-F4): Kuzenga kutoka Ace ku King na kulingana na mutwe
- Mizungu ya kubwatanisha (T1-T7): Kuzenga kwa kushuka na kubadilishana rangi (mwekundu juu ya musweto, musweto juu ya mwekundu)
- Muziko: Kuchora kadi ku mizungu ya kubwatanisha
- Muzungu wa kubwatanisha (W): Kadi ya juu inapatikana kwa mwingilango

Mafumo:
- 'draw' - Chora kadi kutoka muziko ku muzungu wa kubwatanisha
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hamisha kadi kati ya mizungu
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count pia inaweza kuwa 'all', ambayo itajaribu kuhama kadi zote zilizo wazi.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza mwingilango mara moja na kufunga alama yako ya sasa
- Majina ya mizungu: W (muzungu wa kubwatanisha), F1-F4 (mizungu ya kipindi), T1-T7 (mizungu ya kubwatanisha)

Unaweza kutekeleza matendo mengi katika zamu moja kwa kuyatenganisha na vigawanyiko:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Ni wafalme pekee ambao wanaweza kuwekwa kwenye mizungu ya kubwatanisha tupu.
Matendo yanatekelezwa kwa mpangilio - ikiwa moja itashindwa, matendo yaliyosalia yatapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ikiwa unaamini kuwa mwingilango hauwezekani kushinda.
